'''Dolomar spice wine''' was a type of [[Wine/Legends|wine]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dolomar]]. Along with [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]], it was one of the planet's major exports.<ref name="TLCSB" />
